breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet on all four edges and also periodic conditions. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly identified this conflict and only included the Dirichlet boundary condition, thus resolving the inconsistency in line with the ground truth.
